description: This file defines the 'LaunchAgentManager' enum that manages macOS launch agents through plist files and launchctl commands. It includes functions for checking status, enabling/disabling the launch agent, writing plist contents, and executing launchctl commands asynchronously.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if the launch agent plist exists and the launchctl print command succeeds. Returns true if active, false otherwise.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent by writing plist and calling launchctl commands accordingly.

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Writes the plist file with the proper configuration based on the bundle path.

methods.name: plistContents
methods.description: Generates the XML plist string with configuration details for launch agent.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: Runs launchctl commands asynchronously and returns the process's termination status.
